title: /team-onboarding Command (v2.1.101)
description: New slash command that generates a teammate ramp-up guide from the current user's local Claude Code usage patterns. The guide is synthesized from local usage history, CLAUDE.md files, agent definitions, and command patterns — producing onboarding documentation tailored to how the specific repo is actually used. Reduces onboarding friction for new team members or returning users. High relevance: the evolution workspace has extensive CLAUDE.md hierarchy, custom agents, and workflow patterns that have never been documented in a synthesized ramp-up format. One-shot command replaces what currently requires manual documentation of agent usage, helper patterns, and workflow conventions.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic slash command (v2.1.101) requiring zero setup — built-in to Claude Code. Generates teammate ramp-up guides from local CLAUDE.md files, agent definitions, and usage patterns, which is directly valuable for the claude-evolution workspace with its 59-project CLAUDE.md hierarchy, 40+ custom agents, and workflow conventions. Token efficiency is neutral (generates docs, doesn't reduce session costs). Built-in means zero maintenance burden. Community validation is 100 (official Anthropic). Integration complexity is 100 (drop-in, already available). Action: run /team-onboarding in the claude-evolution workspace to generate a ramp-up guide and evaluate output quality.
integration_actions: Run /team-onboarding in ~/claudeworkspace/claude-evolution to generate ramp-up guide
